test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Members of Public Accounts Committee are elected for a period of:
solution:
The correct answer is **__One year.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The members are elected every year from amongst the members of respective houses according to the principle of proportional representation by means of a single transferable vote.
 
• The chairperson is appointed by the Lok Sabha speaker. The term of office of the members is one year.
 
• The Committee consists of 22 Members, 15 Members are elected by Lok Sabha and 7 Members of the Rajya Sabha are associated with it.
 
• The term of office of the members is one year. A minister cannot be elected as a member of the committee. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Public Accounts Committee (PAC) **is a committee of selected members of parliament, constituted by the Parliament of India, for the purpose of auditing the revenue and the expenditure of the Government of India.
 
• They check that parliament exercises over the executive stem from the basic principle that parliament embodies the will of the people.
 
• This committee along with the Estimates committee (EC) and Committee on Public Undertakings (COPU) are the three financial standing committees of the Parliament of India.
 
• It serves as a check on the government, especially with respect to its expenditure bill and its primary function is to examine the audit report of the Comptroller and Auditor General (C&AG) after it is laid in the Parliament.
